# Tubhani Duncan on Facebook: "In America, when someone mentions that they’re currently serving in the military or have served befo…"

In America, when someone mentions that they’re currently serving in the military or have served before, people say, “Thank you for your service.”

In Ghana, instead of “Thank you for your service,” we’ll say “Aban!”, “Mmarima mma!” or “Old soldier never dies!” 😂😂
